title: Observation batch envelope (v1)
description: A chunk of observations belonging to one scan run. Batches are the unit of retry: a batch is applied exactly once per (run_id, batch_id), and every observation inside it is applied exactly once per (run_id, source_key), so replaying an identical batch changes nothing. Absence of an object in a batch means nothing at all - only a reconciled, successful run can imply absence.

batch_id.description: Collector-generated UUID, stable across retries of the same batch. A retry with the same batch_id is acknowledged as a duplicate and applied once.

sequence.description: 1-based batch number within the run. Gaps are permitted (a failed batch may be abandoned), but a completed run reports how many batches it sent so the server can detect loss.

is_final.description: Advisory marker that this is the last batch. It does not complete the run: only the completion envelope does.

continuation_token.description: Opaque collector-side cursor, echoed back for diagnostics. The server never interprets it.

observations.description: At most 1000 observations per batch. A larger batch is rejected rather than truncated: silent truncation would look like coverage.
